full_details: In the morning you set "Susanna, xij" in the almanac. You formed the question for her, a queen who learns bad news by listening to gardeners, and you did not answer it. In the afternoon you played Navarre. You were a line behind the ladies. Augustine Phillips told you the yard did not laugh, and that Wednesday is the same play. At home you left the question open, and at half past six you wrote the sheet. You asked to be told the fault plainly. You said the Master of the Revels had corrected you and that it did you good. Love to Judith and to Hamnet went in the same line. You told Anne the king is two-thirds made. You asked which one thing the house should wait to buy, and you struck your own answer. What is left is a blot. The thimble was 2s 6d and went on the fifteenth. This letter goes by Hobbins on the fifth of June. You promised to hear her read in August.
one_sentence: You marked Susanna twelve, came in a line late as Navarre, and wrote the letter that should have gone with the thimble.
title: A girl of twelve
